$comment: Example of a provisioning file. Each item is written only when an administrator never changed the key (its stored value is empty or equals the default); otherwise it is kept and listed with the reason. Keys of the protected group (network trust, sign-in, alert mail) go through the same checks as memory-admin recover set. Try it first: memory-admin provision apply example.settings.json --dry-run. Secrets (storage keys) are better passed on standard input (provision apply -) than kept in a file.
